                              ORDINANCE

  BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 20-K in the area bounded by


       West      Street; a line from a point 275 feet east of South Cicero
       Avenue and the south right-of-way line of West 81®' Street; to a
       point, 280 feet east of South Cicero Avenue and 600 feet south of
       West 81®' Street; a line 600 feet south of and parallel to West 81®'
       Street; and South Cicero Avenue,


to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
